name: tayga-frontend
description: Tayga Mail web UI (Tailwind) embedded via go:embed

scripts.build: node build-omemo.cjs && node build-pdfjs.cjs && tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ../internal/frontend/dist/assets/app.css --minify && cat ./src/i18n.js ./src/app.js ./src/admin-config.js ./src/mail-images.js ./src/reader-actions.js ./src/calendar-recurrence.js ./src/protection.js ./src/travel.js ./src/rule-builder.js ./src/design-pack.js ./src/file-library.js ./src/file-uploads.js ./src/mail-attachments.js ./src/mail-sources.js ./src/omemo.js ./src/directory.js > ../internal/frontend/dist/assets/app.js && cp ./src/sw.js ../internal/frontend/dist/sw.js
